copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate full materials for historical science short videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce scripts and storyboards for historical science short videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动生成历史科学类3分钟科普短视频的全套素材，包括口播文案、分镜脚本、视频生成提示词和人物形象规范。
howto.when: 当你提出制作历史科学类科普视频的需求，并提供主题、年代背景和核心科学结论时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成“蝴蝶效应的起源”科普视频素材，年代1961年。
say.note: Claude 会调用脚本生成完整素材包。

say.text: 制作青霉素发现的3分钟科普视频，核心结论是“偶然发现”。
say.note: Claude 会输出文案、分镜等文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate a complete set of materials for a 3-minute popular science short video on historical science topics, including narration script, storyboard, Veo2 prompts, and character design.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request to create a historical science popular science video and provide the theme, era, and core scientific conclusion.

say_en.text: Generate video materials for 'The Origin of the Butterfly Effect', era 1961.
say_en.note: Claude will run the script to produce the full material pack.

say_en.text: Create a 3-minute video about the discovery of penicillin, core conclusion 'accidental discovery'.
say_en.note: Claude will output script, storyboard, etc.
